WeKnora est composé d’une interface Web,: WeKnora consists of a Web UI, a Go main service, and a Python document parsing service. Business data is persisted in a database; Redis schedules asynchronous tasks. Vector storage, object storage, the knowledge graph, and model services are configurable per deployment.
L’assistant WeKnora intégré s’appuie sur: The built-in WeKnora Assistant builds on the existing Agent engine, an admin operations catalog, and product documentation shipped with the application. Page context helps interpret the task; actual operations still go through role and resource authorization. Collaboration instances, approvals, and run suspensions are persisted; the automation scheduler starts assistant sessions on behalf of the task owner and records runs and in-app notifications.
